reason: Reviewer must verify: (1) spec's click-through section is updated to reflect the removal of setIgnoreCursorEvents toggling and the rationale; (2) the new pet_get_work_area command is documented with the NSScreen.visibleFrame origin-conversion note; (3) ACL still grants the remaining window calls used (show/hide/set_position/outerPosition).

Check phase verifies no dead code left behind (ignoreRef, the proactive re-enable block in handlePointerDown, the cursor/window fields of PetCursorProbe if unused), no superfluous comments, and tests cover the clamp helper.
Verify the Rust PetWorkArea struct is serde-serialized with the same field names the TS type reads, and that clampPetPosition's input/output types are explicit (no any).
Verify the IPC contract is aligned: Rust command name, payload shape, and the TS caller all match; clamp math is a pure tested helper on the TS side; OS-specific FFI stays in Rust.

Reviewer checks that the existing petPosition.ts helpers (computeDefaultPetPosition, PET_WINDOW_SIZE) are reused rather than duplicated, and that the clamp helper composes with the existing default calc instead of replacing it.
